Hand-written wrappers, loaders, and helpers in sportsdataverse.hockey.vhl that are not generated API-endpoint wrappers (those have their own reference pages).

vhl_tn(season: 'int', stage: 'str' = 'regular') -> 'int' The VHL tournament id (tn) of a season (END year) and stage. Read from the calendar's tournament select, fetched once per process. The tn is what the site keys every season page by; the wrappers map it for you, so you need it only to read tn columns or build a URL by hand. Parameters Returns the tn (1374 for the 2025/26 regular season). Raises Example from sportsdataverse.hockey.vhl import vhl_tn vhl_tn(2026) # 1374 vhl_tn(2026, "playoff") # 1375

sportsdataverse.hockey.vhl — 13 endpoints. Note: Owner flag (sdv-internal-refs/vhl/README.md): the VHL is run by Russian league operators, and several clubs are owned or sponsored by sanctioned state companies. Fetching on your own machine is fine; a published data release or a hosted mirror needs the owner's sanctions / legal sign-off first.
